items.definition:
immeasurable; not revealed
The flood caused untold damage to the region.

able to be attributed to
The success of the project is largely attributable to her hard work.

causing or likely to cause an argument
The issue of climate change remains highly contentious.

well known, respected, and admired for past achievements
The university has an illustrious list of alumni.

possessing or showing courage or determination
The valiant knight fought the dragon.

in the style of; resembling
The painting had a dreamlike, surrealist-esque quality.

examining, including, or considering all elements or aspects; fully comprehensive
They conducted an exhaustive search for the missing documents.

relating to or characteristic of Satan
The old house had a satanic symbol painted on the wall.

resulting from or relating to an irresistible urge, especially one that is against one's conscious wishes
He has a compulsive need to check his phone every few minutes.

(of a disease or physical abnormality) present from birth
The baby was born with a congenital heart defect.

wild, untamed
They found a feral cat living in the woods.

unlikely
It's highly improbable that he will finish the marathon in under two hours.

occurring at irregular intervals or only in a few places; scattered or isolated
The power outages were sporadic throughout the day.

unwarranted or inappropriate because excessive or disproportionate
Don't put undue pressure on yourself.

relating to archives
The researchers spent hours sifting through archival documents.

passionate
He was an ardent supporter of environmental protection.

no longer existing or functioning
The company is now defunct after going bankrupt.

comically or repulsively ugly or distorted
The gargoyles on the old building were grotesque.

able to be exchanged with each other without loss of effectiveness or function
The parts are interchangeable, so you can use either one.

impossible to reverse
The damage to the environment is irreversible.

present as the strongest or main element
The predominant color in the painting was blue.

jointly arranged or carried out; coordinated
They made a concerted effort to finish the project on time.

situated away from the center of the body or from the point of attachment
The hand is distal to the elbow.

serving to form something, especially having a profound influence on a person's development
Her early experiences were a formative influence on her character.

relating to the stomach and intestines
He suffered from a gastrointestinal disorder.

lacking human qualities of compassion and kindness; cruel and barbaric
The prisoners were subjected to inhuman conditions.

hidden; potential
The disease remained latent for several years before symptoms appeared.

clear; easy to understand
Her explanation was so lucid that everyone understood the complex topic.

Not linear; not in a straight line or sequence.
The relationship between effort and results can often be nonlinear.

Living on or in another organism and getting food from it.
The parasitic worm can cause serious health problems.

Small and dainty.
She had a petit frame and delicate features.

Evoking a keen sense of sadness or regret.
The photograph was a poignant reminder of their lost youth.

Not securely held or in position; dangerously likely to fall or collapse.
The climber found himself in a precarious position on the cliff edge.

Denoting or concerning a sect or sects; relating to divisions within a group.
The conflict was fueled by sectarian violence.

extending across something
The bridge had a strong transverse beam for structural support.

accorded a great deal of respect, especially because of age, wisdom, or character
The venerable old professor shared his wisdom with generations of students.

available for use at the discretion of the user
Employees receive a discretionary bonus based on performance.

essentially different in kind; not able to be compared
The team members came from disparate backgrounds.

devout, pious
He lived a simple and godly life.

arranged in order of rank
The company has a strict hierarchical management structure.

characterized by an unhealthy interest in disturbing subjects
He has a morbid fascination with true crime stories.

lasting for a long time or longer than expected
The negotiations were protracted and difficult.

generally considered or believed to be
He is reputed to be the best lawyer in the city.

relating to sociology or to the organization of society
The study examined the sociological impact of technology.

relating to deep inward feelings rather than intellect
He had a visceral reaction to the injustice.

relating to an artery or arteries
The city's arterial roads are often congested during rush hour.

relating to the sense of hearing
The auditory nerve transmits sound signals to the brain.

happening every two years
The art exhibition is a biennial event.

excellent; first-rate (informal)
Everything's just dandy, thanks for asking.

retired but retaining title
She is now a professor emeritus of history.

still in existence
There are very few extant copies of the original manuscript.

utterly odious or wicked
The crime was described as a heinous act.

engaging deeply
The virtual reality game offered a truly immersive experience.

flawless, perfect
Her performance was impeccable.

mutually connected
All living things are interconnected in the ecosystem.

making a certain situation or outcome likely or possible
A quiet environment is conducive to studying.

wishing to do one's work or duty well and thoroughly
She is a very conscientious student.

having the structure and properties of a crystal; clear and transparent
The water in the lake was crystalline.

insulting, disparaging
She made a derogatory remark about his appearance.

proceeding in a gradual, subtle way, but with harmful effects
The insidious disease spread slowly, showing few symptoms at first.

emitting or reflecting light; shining
The moon was a luminous orb in the night sky.

showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise
The artist was meticulous in her brushstrokes, ensuring every detail was perfect.

Male-dominated
Many ancient societies were patriarchal.

Necessary
He has the requisite experience for the job.
